Testing directories with dots in their name. To make sure that resolve_target
run from them considers them directories, not files. Also tests how that
interacts with sub-target queries which also use dots.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module mod.test/resolvetarget

go 1.25

-- a/b.v2/b.go --

package b

var B = "B" //@target(B_v2, "mod.test/resolvetarget/a/b.v2", "B", "B")

-- a/b.v2/ --

//@resolvetarget("B", "mod.test/resolvetarget/a/b.v2", B_v2)
